int_name: S CROSKEY ST & MC KEAN ST

result.summary: A narrow residential street with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. The environment lacks formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or signage, and parked vehicles on the right side create visual obstructions.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks at the intersection to guide pedestrians or alert drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the crossing inaccessible for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the foreground intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the intersection on the right side block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with mixed-use buildings and sidewalks on both sides, but it lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control infrastructure. Parked vehicles along both curbs create significant visual obstructions, forcing pedestrians to enter the roadway from between cars to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous lines of parked cars on both sides of the street block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly at potential crossing points.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible street.

hazards.name: Lack of Designated Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks or curb ramps makes it unclear where pedestrians should cross and provides no priority for them.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near corners to improve visibility between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint to clearly define pedestrian paths.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban intersection with sidewalks but no marked crosswalks or curb ramps. The proximity of buildings to the street corners creates significant sightline obstructions for both pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps

hazards.name: Blind corners

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA curb ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Signage
interventions.description: Ensure clear sightlines at corners and install stop or yield signs to manage traffic flow at the intersection.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban street with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. While the narrow street width likely discourages high speeds, the environment lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic calming measures.
